evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
evidence.MCL: The contour of MCL is in a straight line but increase signal intensity inside, in favor of grade 1 injury.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Small size of posterior horn of medial meniscus and absent bow-tie sign, in favor of tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: No strong MR evidence of tear of lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Wearing of articular cartilage and osteophyte of right knee with subchondral edema over medial compartment, reflecting osteoarthritis.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Baker's: A lobulated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst.
evidence.Contusion: subchondral edema over medial compartment, reflecting osteoarthritis.
